name: kitty-drop-mobile
description: Expo (iOS + Android) shell that hosts the Kitty Drop web game in a WebView.

scripts.build:ios: npm run bundle && npx --yes eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.build:ios:sim: npm run bundle && npx --yes eas-cli build --platform ios --profile simulator
scripts.build:android: npm run bundle && npx --yes eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview
